blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model capacity through sparse computation, routing each token through only a small subset of experts. In this work, we explore whether this sparsity gives rise to emergent intrinsic organization in multimodal MoEs. We find that experts develop strong semantic specialization across modalities and domains despite not being explicitly trained for modularity. Building on this structure, we introduce ExpertLens , a data-free method that identifies domain-specialized experts directly from pretrained model weights by decoding router weights into semantically meaningful vocabulary tokens. We leverage this specialization for efficient multimodal adaptation by selectively fine-tuning experts relevant to a target domain. Across math, medical, and remote sensing tasks, ExpertLens matches or surpasses full fine-tuning while updating only 21.7 21.7 – 47.0 % 47.0\% of model parameters and achieving a 4.0 × 4.0\times average training speedup, and outperforms LoRA in both adaptation performance and training efficiency. These results show that sparsity introduced for efficiency can give rise to semantic modularity that is directly useful for efficient adaptation. Project Page : glab-caltech.github.io/expertlens Code : github.com/damianomarsili/ExpertLens
blocks.zh: Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)架构通过稀疏的计算来进行规模模型容量,每个符号仅通过一小部分专家来进行路由. 在这项工作中,我们探讨这种麻痹是否在多式联运中产生了新兴的内在组织。 我们发现,尽管专家没有接受模块化方面的明确培训,但他们在模式和领域都发展出强有力的语义专业化。 在这个结构的基础上,我们引入了"专家伦斯"(ExecutiveLens),这是一种无数据方法,通过将路由器的权重解码为精密有意义的词汇符来识别域专门化专家,直接从预先训练过的模型权重中识别出. 我们通过有选择地微调与目标领域有关的专家,利用这种专业化,高效率地调整多式联运。 在整个数学、医学和遥感任务中,ExpertLens匹配或超越了全面的微调,而仅更新了21.7 21.7 – 47.0 % 47.0% 的模型参数,实现了4.0×4.0\时间的平均训练速度,在适应性能和培训效率方面都超过了LORA。 这些结果显示,为提高效率而引入的斯帕力可产生语义模块化,直接有利于高效的适应. 项目页:glab-caltech.github.io/ 专家代码:github.com/damianomarsili/ 专家Lens

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become a key ingredient in scaling modern language and multimodal models ( Gemma Team et al., 2026 ; Kimi Team et al., 2025 ) . By replacing dense feed-forward layers with many experts while activating only a small subset for each token, MoEs decouple model capacity from per-token computation ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; McGill and Perona, 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ) . This sparsity has enabled models to scale to enormous sizes while remaining computationally tractable ( Kimi Team, 2026 ; Thinking Machines, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 架构已成为现代语言和多模式模型缩放的关键成分(Gemma Team等,2026;Kimi) Team等,2025 (英语). 通过用许多专家取代密集的向导分层,同时激活每个代号的一小子集,MOEs将模型容量从每个代号的计算中解开(Shazeer等人,2017年;McGill和Perona,2017年;Fedus等人,2022年)。 这种相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相

blocks.en: Sparsity in MoEs was introduced primarily for efficiency, not organization ( Lepikhin et al., 2020 ) . Experts are learned jointly, with a router selecting a subset per token. Yet consistent routing patterns could induce implicit modularity, with experts specializing to different kinds of information. Such structure has been studied in text-only MoEs ( Antoine et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , but only recently in multimodal models ( Xu et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , where the same expert layers process both visual and textual representations. We therefore ask whether sparse multimodal MoEs are semantically organized: do experts specialize by modality, domain, and visual concept?
blocks.zh: 教育部实行平等,主要是提高效率,而不是组织(Lepikhin等人,2020年)。 专家是共同学习的,由路由器选择每个符号的子集. 然而,连贯一致的路由模式可能诱发隐含的模块化,由专家专门处理不同种类的信息。 这种结构在仅以文字表示的MOEs(Antoine等,2025;Li等,2026)中被研究过,但直到最近才在多式模型(徐等,2026b;张等,2026)中,同一专家层同时处理视觉和文字表述. 因此,我们问,稀有的多式联运企业是否组织严密:专家是否按模式、领域和视觉概念而具有专长?

blocks.en: In this work, we find that multimodal MoEs develop striking semantic specialization without explicitly training for it. Across three large multimodal MoEs, experts exhibit strong modality specialization, preferentially processing visual or textual tokens (§ 3.1 ). Beyond modality, visual representations and routing organize strongly by semantic domain: medical, math, and remote sensing imagery form distinct structures not explained by low-level properties such as color or spatial position (§ 3.2 ). This extends to finer semantics, with visually dissimilar but semantically related object classes recruiting overlapping expert sets (§ 3.3 ). Thus, sparsity introduced for computational efficiency gives rise to an emergent semantic decomposition of multimodal MoEs.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们发现,多式联运企业发展出引人注目的语义专业,而没有明确培训。 在三个大型多式企业部中,专家表现出很强的专业化模式,优先处理可视化或文字符号(第3.1节)。 除模式外,视觉表现和路由按语义领域强烈地组织起来:医学、数学和遥感图像形成不同的结构,而不以低等特性如颜色或空间位置来解释(第3.2节)。 这延伸到精细的语义学,视线不同但与众不同的物体类招聘重叠的专家(第3.3节)。 因此,为计算效率而引入的螺旋分解导致多式联运的语义分解。

blocks.en: This emergent structure raises a practical question: given an MoE, how can we identify which experts specialize in a given domain? To this end, we introduce ExpertLens , a data-free method that recovers expert semantics directly from pretrained weights by decoding router weights into semantically meaningful vocabulary tokens (§ 3.4 ). ExpertLens enables identification of experts relevant to a domain without requiring domain-specific examples.
blocks.zh: 这种新兴结构提出了一个实际问题:鉴于教育部,我们如何确定哪些专家专门从事某一领域? 为此,我们引入了ExpertLens,一种无数据方法,它通过将路由器的分量解码为精密有意义的词汇符号(§3.4),直接从预先训练的分量中恢复出专家的语义. 专家名册可以识别与某一领域有关的专家,而不需要特定领域的实例。

blocks.en: We next ask whether this emergent specialization can enable more efficient multimodal adaptation (§ 4 ). Using ExpertLens , we selectively adapt experts relevant to each domain while freezing the remaining expert MLPs. Across sequential adaptation to math, medical, and remote sensing tasks, this strategy matches or surpasses full fine-tuning while updating only 21.7 21.7 – 47.0 % 47.0\% of model parameters and achieving a 4.0 × 4.0\times average speedup. ExpertLens also outperforms LoRA in both adaptation performance and training speed ( 2.9 × 2.9\times faster). Thus, the emergent specialization of multimodal MoEs is not only interpretable, but directly useful for efficient adaptation.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来要问的是,这种新兴的专门化是否能够促进更有效的多式联运适应(第4节)。 使用专家Lens, 通过对数学、医学和遥感任务的相继适应,这一策略匹配或超越了全面的微调,同时仅更新了21.7、21.7、47.0%、47.0%、47.0%、以及4.0x4.0\时间的平均速度。 专家 镜头在适应性能和训练速度上也优于LORA( 2.9 × 2.9分快). 因此,多式联运企业的新兴专业化不仅可以解释,而且直接有助于有效的适应。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • We uncover emergent semantic structure in multimodal MoEs, showing specialization across modalities, semantic domains, and fine-grained visual concepts. • We introduce ExpertLens , a data-free method that decodes router weights to identify the semantic specialization of individual experts. • We demonstrate that emergent modularity enables efficient multimodal adaptation, matching full fine-tuning and outperforming LoRA while reducing training time by over 4 × 4\times on average.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的贡献是: 我们发现在多式联运模式中出现的语义结构,显示出不同模式、语义领域和精细视觉概念的专业化。 我们引入了ExpertLens,一种解码路由器权重的无数据方法,以识别个别专家的语义专业. 我们证明,新兴模块化能够有效地进行多模式调整,使完全调整和业绩优于LORA,同时将培训时间平均减少4×4\次以上。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Mixture-of-Experts. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have a long history in conditional computation, scaling model capacity by sparsely routing each input through a subset of expert modules ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Jacobs et al., 1991 ) . Sparse MoEs were later incorporated into large-scale Transformers ( Lepikhin et al., 2020 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ; Dai et al., 2024 ) , and are now common for scaling modern language models ( Kimi Team, 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026a ) and multimodal foundation models ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Gemma Team et al., 2026 ; Kimi Team et al., 2025 ; Thinking Machines, 2026 ) . We provide a brief overview of MoE routing and notation in § A.1 .
blocks.zh: Mixture-of-Experts. Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)架构在有条件的计算方面有着悠久的历史,通过一个子集的专家模块(Shazeer等,2017;Jacobs等,1991.)通过稀疏的路由来缩小模型容量. 分页 教育部后来被并入了大规模变形器(Lepikhin等,2020年;Fedus等,2022年;Jiang等,2024年;Dai等,2024年),现在常见于现代语言模型(Kimi Team,2026年;Xu等,2026年a年)和多模式基础模型(Bai等,2025年;Gemma). blocks.en: Interpreting Internal Representations. Mechanistic interpretability seeks to reverse-engineer neural networks into human-understandable mechanisms using tools such as circuit analysis, causal interventions, and representation decoding ( Elhage et al., 2021 ; Meng et al., 2023 ; Conmy et al., 2023 ) . Logit Lens ( nostalgebraist, 2020 ) applies a model’s output head to intermediate residual-stream representations to expose how predictions evolve across layers. This is motivated by the residual stream’s approximately linear, additive structure ( Elhage et al., 2021 ) and evidence that transformer MLPs write semantically meaningful, vocabulary-aligned updates into it ( Geva et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . Subsequent variants have extended this idea to decoding internal representations in LLMs and VLMs ( Belrose et al., 2025 ; Pal et al., 2023 ; Neo et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 解读内部代表. 机械解释性寻求利用诸如电路分析、因果干预和表示解码等工具,将神经网络反向工程化为人可理解的机制(Elhage等,2021;Meng等,2023;Conmy等,2023)。 Logit Lens(怀旧代数学家,2020年)将一个模型的输出头应用到中间残流表达来揭示预测如何跨层演化. 这是由于残余溪流的约线性、添加剂结构(Elhage等,2021年)以及变压器MLPs在其中写出富有意义的、词汇相匹配的更新的证据(Geva等,2022年;Wu等,2025年)。 随后的变体将这个想法扩展为对LLMs和VLMs中的内部表示进行解码(Belrose等,2025;Pal等,2023;Neo等,2025.).

blocks.en: Interpretability of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models remains comparatively underexplored. Prior work has used attribution and ablation to identify behaviorally important experts ( Hu et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , manipulated routing or expert activation to steer behavior ( Fayyaz et al., 2025 ) , and decoded individual expert contributions into output space ( Chaudhari et al., 2026 ) . We extend this line of work with ExpertLens , a data-free method for decoding expert semantics and identifying domain-specialized experts for efficient adaptation.
blocks.zh: 混合专家模型的可解释性仍然比较不足。 先前的工作利用归属和贬低识别行为重要的专家(Hu等,2026;Li等,2025),被操纵的路由或专家活化来引导行为(Fayyaz等,2025),并解码个人专家对输出空间的贡献(Chaudhari等,2026). 我们扩展了与ExpertLens的这一条工作线,这是对专家语义进行解码和确定域专门化专家的有效适应的一种无数据方法。

blocks.en: Expert Specialization. Prior work on text-only MoEs has found emergent expert structure, including specialization by token type and part of speech ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Antoine et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . However, this structure is typically low-level rather than aligned with broader semantic domains. To encourage higher-level organization, EMO ( Wang et al., 2026 ) modifies text-only MoE pretraining to promote domain-level modularity. Expert organization in multimodal MoEs remains less explored, with recent work examining routing across visual, textual, and reasoning stages ( Xu et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, we find that pretrained multimodal MoEs develop rich semantic organization spanning modalities, domains, and fine-grained visual concepts.
blocks.zh: 专家专攻. 先前关于仅文本的教育部的工作已经发现有新兴的专家结构,包括按符号类型和部分语音的专业化(Jiang等,2024;Antoine等,2025;Li等,2026)。 然而,这种结构一般是低等的,而不是与更广泛的语义域相配合. 为了鼓励更高层次的组织,EMO(Wang等,2026年)修改了只有文本的MOE预训,以推广域级模块化. 多式联运模式的专家组织仍然较少得到探讨,最近的工作是研究跨越视觉、文字和推理阶段的路线(徐等,2026年b;张等,2026年)。 相比之下,我们发现,经过预先培训的多式电子模型发展出丰富的语义组织,涵盖模式、域和精细的视觉概念。

blocks.en: Parameter Efficient Adaptation. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA reduce adaptation cost by introducing a small number of trainable parameters while keeping the pretrained model frozen ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . Recent work extends low-rank adaptation to MoE models, applying LoRA updates to shared and/or expert parameters ( Wei et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, our approach exploits the pretrained model’s existing expert structure, selectively updating the experts most relevant to the target domain. In direct comparison, ExpertLens achieves higher adaptation performance than LoRA while also reducing training time more substantially.
blocks.zh: 参数高效适应。 LoRA等参数高效微调方法通过引入少量可训练参数来降低适应成本,同时使预训练模型保持了被冻结(Hu等,2022). 最近的工作扩展了对教育部模型的低级适应,将LORA更新应用到共享和/或专家参数(Wei等,2026;Liu等,2026). 相比之下,我们的方法利用了预先训练过的模型现有的专家结构,有选择地更新与目标领域最相关的专家。 直接比较之下,ExpertLens的适应性能比LORA更高,同时也能更大幅度地缩短培训时间.

blocks.en: 3 Emergent Structure in Mixture-of-Experts VLMs
blocks.zh: 3 专家组合中的新结构

blocks.en: Mixture-of-Experts models provide a natural opportunity for functional specialization within their expert modules, but it remains unclear whether such specialization emerges in pretrained models and, if so, how it is organized. We explore this idea via three questions:
blocks.zh: 专家混合模型为专家模块中的功能专业化提供了自然的机会,但这种专业化是否出现在预先训练的模型中,如果是,如何组织,仍然不清楚。 我们通过三个问题探讨这个想法:

blocks.en: 1. Do experts specialize on different modalities? 2. Do experts specialize on different semantic domains within a modality? 3. Does this specialization persist at finer-grained, object-level semantics?
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 专家是否专门研究不同的方式? 2. 专家是否专门研究某种模式内不同的语义领域? 3. 这种专门化在更精细的、物体级的语义上是否继续存在?

blocks.en: Do experts specialize on different modalities?
blocks.zh: 专家是否专门研究不同的方式?

blocks.en: Do experts specialize on different semantic domains within a modality?
blocks.zh: 专家是否专门研究某种模式内不同的语义领域?

blocks.en: Does this specialization persist at finer-grained, object-level semantics?
blocks.zh: 这种专业在更精细的,对象级的语义上是否继续存在?

blocks.en: Answering these questions can provide insight into how multimodal MoEs organize their internal representations, while also revealing whether their modular structure can be exploited for efficient, targeted adaptation. We study these questions across three frontier multimodal MoEs: Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , Kimi-VL-A3B ( Kimi Team et al., 2025 ) , and Gemma-4 26B-A4B ( Gemma Team et al., 2026 ) . We conclude by introducing ExpertLens , a data-free method for identifying domain-specialized experts from expert router weights.
blocks.zh: 回答这些问题可以使人们深入了解多式联运是如何实现的。 教育部组织内部代表,同时揭示其模块结构能否被利用来进行高效、有针对性的调整。 我们跨越三个边界研究这些问题: Qune3-VL-30B-A3B (Bai等,2025年),Kimi-VL-A3B (Kimi Team等,2025年),和Gemma-4 26B-A4B (Gemma Team等,2026年). 最后,我们引入了ExpertLens,这是从专家路由器重量中确定域专门专家的一种无数据方法。

blocks.en: Throughout this section, we use a suite of VQA datasets spanning general, medical, math/scientific, and remote-sensing domains to probe MoE expert behavior across image patches and text tokens. For text-only analyses, we additionally include broader linguistic domains such as legal and abstract reasoning. We include all datasets used and additional experimental details in § A.2 .
blocks.zh: 在整个这一节中,我们使用一组涵盖一般、医学、数学/科学和遥感领域的VQA数据集,在图像补丁和文本符号之间探索MOE专家行为。 对于仅以文字为主的分析,我们还包括更广泛的语言领域,例如法律和抽象推理。 我们在§A.2中包含了所有使用的数据集和额外的实验细节.

blocks.en: 3.1 Expert Specialization by Modality
blocks.zh: 3.1 模式专家专业化

blocks.en: We first ask whether multimodal MoEs exhibit modality-specific routing. In particular, do individual experts preferentially process visual or textual tokens, and is specialization distributed similarly across modalities? Establishing such structure would indicate that experts in pretrained multimodal MoEs are not interchangeable, but develop distinct functional preferences. To this end, we measure modality affinity from each expert’s activation counts on modality-specific tokens. We sample 3,840 3{,}840 image patches and equally many text tokens from seven datasets spanning general VQA, medical imaging, and math/science reasoning. Under the expert activation definition (§ A.1 ), we define affinity as the fraction of each expert’s top- K K activations from image versus text tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们首先要问的是,多式联运企业是否展示特定模式的路由。 特别是,个别专家是否优先处理可视化或文字符号,专业化是否在各种模式之间分布类似? 建立这种结构将表明,经过预先培训的多式联运企业的专家是不可互换的,而是形成不同的功能偏好。 为此,我们以特定模式的标志来衡量每位专家的激活方式的亲和性。 我们抽样了3,840 3{,}840个图像补丁和同样多的文本符号,它们来自7个数据集,涵盖一般的VQA,医学成像和数学/科学推理. 根据专家激活定义(§A.1),我们将亲和性定义为每个专家从图像到文字符号的上-K活化的分量.

blocks.en: Experts develop modality-specific routing. Figure 1 A shows, for each expert, the fraction of top- K K activations arising from image versus text tokens. The x axis indexes experts within each layer; orange-dominated experts favor image tokens, and purple-dominated experts favor text. Across layers, activations are rarely balanced between modalities. Instead, many experts strongly prefer one, indicating that modality specialization emerges naturally in pretrained multimodal MoEs.
blocks.zh: 专家制定特定方式的路由. 图1 A显示每个专家从图像对文本符号产生的上-K K活化的分量。 X轴索引每层内的专家;橙色为主的专家倾向于图像符号,紫色为主的专家倾向于文本. 跨地层,激活方式之间很少平衡. 相反,许多专家强烈倾向于一种,表明模式专业化在经过预先培训的多式联运企业中自然出现。

blocks.en: Modality specialization tends to be bimodal and asymmetric. We pool experts across layers by text-token activation share. Without modality preference, the distribution should peak near 50 % 50\% ; instead, Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B is clearly bimodal (Figure 1 B), with an image-leaning mode at 0 0 – 5 % 5\% text share ( 462 462 experts) and a text-leaning mode at 60 60 – 65 % 65\% ( 433 433 experts). blocks.en: 3.2 Domain Specificity in Vision and Text Experts
blocks.zh: 3.2 愿景和文本专家领域的具体性

blocks.en: Having established modality preferences, we next ask whether specialization extends to semantic domains. Do some experts preferentially process medical over math inputs? We test whether visual and textual representations organize differently by domain, and whether this structure reflects semantics rather than linguistic factors or low-level visual statistics. We first examine this with t-SNE projections of token activations and router weights, then quantify it using kNN purity.
blocks.zh: 在确定了模式偏好之后,我们接下来问专业化是否延伸到语义领域。 一些专家是否优先处理医疗投入而不是数学投入? 我们检验视觉和文字表达方式是否按域组织不同,这种结构是否反映语义而非语言因素或低等视觉统计. 我们首先用T-SNE对活化物和路由器重量的预测来检查,然后用kNN纯度来量化.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Visual activations exhibit stronger domain structure than textual activations. We project layer-18 text-token and image-patch activations with router weights from Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B using t-SNE. (A) : Datasets are colored and separated by modality; image activations form tighter domain-specific clusters than text. (B) : All domains shown together.
blocks.zh: 图2:视觉活化显示的域结构比文字活化显示的更强. 我们利用t-SNE从Qune3-VL-30B-A3B 投射出带有路由器重量的 第18层文本键和图像-patch活化器。 (A):数据集通过模式来配色并相隔;图像活化形成更紧凑的域特有集群,而不是文本. (B) : 所有域一起显示。

blocks.en: Visual activations exhibit strong domain structure. We ask whether modality specialization extends to semantic domains by examining the representations that drive expert routing. Because routing depends directly on token activations, domain structure in this space could induce domain-specific expert use. We sample 1.5 1.5 K image patches and text tokens from each of six VQA datasets spanning medical, math, and remote sensing domains ( 18 18 K activations total), and jointly project them with all the router weights in Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B using t-SNE. Figure 2 shows layer 18 as an exemplar, with similar patterns across layers and models (§ A.4.6 ).
blocks.zh: 视觉活化呈现出强域结构. 我们问,模式专业化是否通过审查推动专家路线的表述而扩大到语义领域。 因为路由直接依赖于符号活化,所以这个空间中的域结构可以诱发特定域的专家使用. 我们从覆盖医学、数学和遥感领域的6个VQA数据集(总共18个18K活化)中分别抽取1.5个1.5K图像补丁和文字符号,并用t-SNE来用所有路由器重量进行联合投影。 图2显示第18层是一个实例,各层和模型的图案相似(§A.4.6)。

blocks.en: Figure 2 reveals two trends. First, image-patch activations form tighter domain-specific clusters than text-token activations, with datasets from the same domain overlapping substantially. For example, breast histopathology and MedMnist cluster together, as do RsVqaLr and RsVqaHr , suggesting that the structure reflects domain rather than dataset identity. Second, router weights concentrate near image activations, while text activations are more diffuse. Together, these observations suggest that visual representations exhibit the domain structure that could induce domain-specific routing.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了两种趋势。 首先,图像-patch活化与文本键活化相比,形成更紧凑的域特有集群,来自同域的数据集在很大程度上重叠. 例如,乳房组织病理学和MedMnist群集在一起,RsVqaLr和RsVqaHr也一样,说明结构反映了域而不是数据集身份. 第二,路由器重量集中在图像活化附近,而文本活化则更加分散. 这些观测结果合在一起表明,可视化表现呈现出可诱发特定域通路的域结构.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Visual activations organize by domain; textual activations by linguistic structure. We measure kNN purity across layers, grouping text activations by dataset or part of speech and image activations by dataset, color, or spatial position. Text activations align most with part of speech, while image activations align best with semantic domain.
blocks.zh: 图3:视觉活化按域排列;文字活化按语言结构排列. 我们通过各层来测量 kNN 纯度, 通过数据集或部分语音和图像激活 组合文本激活 通过数据集、颜色或空间位置。 文本活化与部分语音一致,而图像活化与语义域最一致.

blocks.en: Quantifying domain structure with kNN purity. The t-SNE analysis suggests strong domain structure in visual activations, but not which factors best explain it. We therefore quantify local activation-space structure using kNN purity: for each activation, we measure the fraction of its k k nearest neighbors sharing the same label, where higher purity indicates better alignment with the local representation geometry. For text tokens, we compare groupings by dataset or part of speech; for image patches, by dataset, mean color, or spatial position. Each grouping contains 12 balanced categories. Further details are in § A.2.2 . We report results across several values of k k in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 以 kNN 纯度量化域结构. t-SNE分析表明在视觉活化中具有很强的域结构,但并不是哪些因素能最好地解释. 因此,我们用 kNN 纯度量化本地活化- 空间结构: 对于每次活化,我们测量其K k 近邻中共享同一标签的分量,其中更纯度表明与本地代表几何更加一致. 对于文本符,我们通过数据集或部分语音来比较分组;对于图像补丁,通过数据集,平均颜色,或空间位置来比较. 每组包含12个平衡的类别. 详情见A.2.2节。 我们在图3中报告若干K值的结果。

blocks.en: Vision and text representations organize differently. Figure 3 shows that text-token activations are better organized by part of speech than by domain, consistent with the findings in prior analyses of the experts of text-only MoEs ( Antoine et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2024 ) . In contrast, image-patch activations achieve highest kNN purity when grouped by dataset, substantially exceeding mean color or spatial patch position. This pattern holds across layers and both Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B and Kimi-VL-A3B . These results support the t-SNE analysis and suggest that visual domain organization is not explained by low-level properties such as color or spatial location.
blocks.zh: 设想和文字表述组织方式不同。 图3显示,文本脚本活化按部分语音排列比按域排列要好,这与仅文本部专家先前分析的结果是一致的(Antoine等人,2025;Jiang等人,2024)。 相形之下,图像-patch活化在被数据集组合时实现了最高的kNN纯度,大大地超过了正色或空间补丁位置. 这种图案横跨地层,并有Qune3-VL-30B-A3B和Kimi-VL-A3B两种. 这些结果支持t-SNE分析,并暗示视觉域组织并非由颜色或空间位置等低等属性来解释.

blocks.en: 3.3 Visual Expert Specialization by Object Semantics
blocks.zh: 3.3 视觉专家专攻对象语义

blocks.en: With domain structure in visual representations established, we then ask if specialization extends to finer-grained semantics. We test whether visually distinct but semantically related classes recruit similar expert sets. To isolate semantics from dataset effects, we conduct the analysis entirely within TinyImageNet ( Le et al., 2015 ) , comparing overlap between related and unrelated classes.
blocks.zh: 随着视觉表达中域结构的建立,我们接着问专业是否延伸到了细纹语义. 我们测试视线独特但与众不同的班级是否招聘类似的专家。 为了将语义学从数据集效应中分离出来,我们完全在TinyImageNet(Le等,2015年)内部进行分析,比较相关类和无关类之间的重叠.

blocks.en: Measuring semantic expert overlap. We use all 200 TinyImageNet classes, forming 19,900 19{,}900 object-class pairs spanning a range of semantic similarity, and sample 100 images per class. For each image, we track which experts activate on its patch tokens. An expert counts as active only if it activates on at least m m patches, for m ∈ { 3 , 5 , 8 , 12 , 16 } m\in\{3,5,8,12,16\} . For each class and layer, we retain experts active in at least 60 % 60\% of that class’s images. We then measure Jaccard overlap between each class pair’s expert sets and standardize it with a score Z ⁡ ( a , b ) Z(a,b) relative to all class pairs, where larger values indicate stronger shared specialization. Details and score calculations are in § A.2.3 .
blocks.zh: 测量语义专家重叠. 我们使用所有的200个TinyImageNet类,组成了19,900个19{,}900个对象类对,跨越了语义相似的范围,每个类对100个图像进行抽样. 对于每个图像,我们跟踪专家 激活它的补丁符号。 专家只有在至少活化于 m m 补丁上,才能计算为活性,为 m { 3, 5, 8, 12, 16} m\in 3, 5, 8, 12, 16\ 。 我们保留至少60 % 的 专家。 然后,我们衡量每个班组的专家组的Jaccard重叠情况,并将其标准化,比照所有班组的分数Z-(a、b)Z(a、b),其中较大的数值表明共享的专业性更强。 详细情况和分数计算见A.2.3节。

Solid lines average thresholds m ∈ { 3 , 5 , 8 , 12 , 16 } m\in\{3,5,8,12,16\} , shading denotes ± 1 \pm 1 standard deviation, and the gray dashed line shows unrelated pairs.

blocks.en: Semantically related classes activate similar experts. Figure 4 shows that related class pairs share more experts than unrelated pairs across layers. In Figure 4 A, semantic distance measured by WordNet Wu-Palmer distance ( Wu and Palmer, 1994 ) is inversely correlated with expert-set overlap: larger distance indicates lower semantic relatedness. For the purpose of providing an overview, the semantic overlap scores are shown averaged across all activation thresholds and all model layers. Figure 4 B provides a finer-grained view using 10 TinyImageNet classes forming five semantically related pairs, without averaging across layers or patch thresholds. Their specialization scores remain above the gray unrelated-class baseline, with several pairs reaching Z ⁡ ( a , b ) > 3 Z(a,b)>3 in intermediate layers, i.e., more than three standard deviations above baseline. These results show that visual expert specialization extends beyond coarse domains to finer-grained object semantics.

blocks.en: Semantic overlap persists despite visual variation. Importantly, high expert overlap is not limited to visually similar classes. Figure 4 B shows that while some related pairs, such as trains and freight cars, share visual structure, others, such as jellyfish and sea slugs or tabbies and golden retrievers, differ substantially in appearance and background. Yet they recruit similar expert sets. We observe the same object-level specialization in other MoE-VLMs (§ A.4.4 ). Together, our analyses suggest that visual expert specialization reflects semantics rather than dataset identity or low-level similarity.

blocks.en: 3.4 ExpertLens: Identifying Domain-Specialized Experts
blocks.zh: 3.4 专家名册:确定领域专家

blocks.en: Our analyses show that multimodal MoEs develop domain specialization, but identifying these experts has required domain-specific examples to observe routing behavior. This is limiting for targeted adaptation, where we would prefer to identify experts for a new domain without representative data. We therefore ask: can we recover an expert’s semantic specialization from its routing weights? We introduce ExpertLens , a data-free method that decodes semantic preferences from router weights.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析表明,多式联运企业发展了域专门化,但确定这些专家需要特定域的例子来观察出出行方式行为. 这限制了有针对性的适应工作,我们倾向于在没有代表性数据的情况下确定新的领域的专家。 因此,我们问:我们能否从一位专家的去向权重中恢复其语义上的专长? 我们引入了ExpertLens,一种从路由器重量中解码语义偏好无数据的方法.

If token representations encode semantics, then a domain-specialized expert’s router weight should align with semantically related directions. We thus map each router weight through the model’s LM head to obtain vocabulary-token logits, analogous to logit-lens decoding ( Belrose et al., 2025 ) . Medical, math, and remote-sensing datasets most strongly recruit their corresponding expert cohorts, except for weaker math alignment on text tokens. This indicates that ExpertLens ’s decoded preferences closely track the inputs that activate each expert.

blocks.en: 4 Domain-Specialized Experts for Efficient Adaptation
blocks.zh: 4. 有效适应领域专家

blocks.en: In § 3 we observed that multimodal MoEs develop domain-specialized experts. We now ask whether this structure can enable more efficient adaptation. In particular, can selectively adapting domain-relevant experts match full fine-tuning while reducing post-training parameters and compute?
blocks.zh: 在§3中,我们观察到,多式联运和电子商务部发展了专门领域专家。 我们现在问,这一结构是否能够使适应工作更加有效。 特别是,能否有选择地调整与域有关的专家在减少培训后参数和计算的同时进行充分的微调?

blocks.en: Sequential Adaptation Protocol. To study this, we adapt a single model sequentially to math, medical, and remote sensing. Rather than resetting to the pretrained checkpoint between domains, this protocol tests whether targeted expert adaptation remains effective as the same model is repeatedly adapted. We evaluate all three domains throughout training and study domain ordering in § 4.3 .
blocks.zh: 后续适应议定书。 为了研究这一点,我们按顺序调整了一个单一模型, 用于数学、医学和遥感。 该议定书不是重新设置事先经过培训的域间检查站,而是检验目标专家的适应是否仍然有效,因为同一模式是反复调整的。 我们评价所有三个领域,按第4.3节排列培训和研究领域。

blocks.en: Selective Adaptation. We identify domain experts with the ExpertLens method (§ 3.4 ) and select those with S EL ≥ 0.9 S_{\mathrm{EL}}\geq 0.9 . For Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B , this yields 2,768 2{,}768 , 1,103 1{,}103 , and 1,290 1{,}290 experts for math, medical, and remote sensing. The sets are largely distinct (Jaccard overlap: 0.13 % 0.13\% math–medical, 6.48 % 6.48\% math–remote sensing, 13.20 % 13.20\% medical–remote sensing). We tune selected expert MLPs, freezing all others and the vision encoder. We also train shared decoder parameters, including QKV projections, router weights, and the LM head (§ 4.3 ). As expert MLPs contain most model parameters, 53.0 53.0 – 78.3 % 78.3\% of the model is frozen. We call this procedure ExpertLens throughout.

blocks.en: Train and Evaluation Setup. We train on 4,000 4{,}000 examples per domain and evaluate on multiple benchmarks spanning math, medical, and remote sensing. Training datasets, evaluation benchmarks, and implementation details are in § A.5 . We use the system prompt and rewards from VERO ( Sarch et al., 2026 ) , Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B as the base MoE, and GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) for post-training. We train for 200 200 steps per domain on 4 4 H200 GPUs with batch size 32 32 and group size 5 5 . Results use three seeds, with shaded regions showing 95 % 95\% confidence intervals.

ExpertLens achieves a 4.0 × 4.0\times average speedup over FFT while matching performance, and a 2.9 × 2.9\times speedup over LoRA.

blocks.en: 4.1 ExpertLens for Efficient Multimodal Adaptation
blocks.zh: 4.1 高效率多式联运适应专家名册

blocks.en: We evaluate whether selectively fine-tuning domain-specialized experts provides an effective alternative to both full-model and parameter-efficient adaptation. We compare ExpertLens against full fine-tuning (FFT) and LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) with the same data, objective, and sequential adaptation protocol. For LoRA, we evaluate ranks R ∈ { 32 , 64 } R\!\in\!\{32,64\} with α = 2 ​ R \alpha\!=\!2R following prior work ( Shuttleworth et al., 2025 ) , and report the best configuration ( R = 32 R\!=\!32 ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价有选择地微调域专家是否为全面模型和参数高效的适应提供了有效的替代办法。 我们比较了ExpertLens与完全微调(FFT)和LORA(Hu等人,2022年)的数据、目标和相继的适应协议。 对LORA来说,我们评价R { { 32, 64} R\!\!} { { 32, 64} { } 与 α = 2 R \ alpha\!} { !2R } 跟随先前的工作( Shuttleworth 等, 2025年), 并报告最佳配置( R = 32 R\! > 32 !) 。

blocks.en: ExpertLens matches FFT and outperforms LoRA. Figure 6 A shows ExpertLens matches or surpasses FFT throughout adaptation while updating only 21.7 21.7 – 47.0 % 47.0\% of model parameters. At the end of each training stage, ExpertLens achieves 64.6 % 64.6\% versus 63.8 % 63.8\% on math, 53.7 % 53.7\% versus 53.6 % 53.6\% on medical, and 51.9 % 51.9\% versus 51.6 % 51.6\% on remote sensing. LoRA reaches 55.8 % 55.8\% , 52.0 % 52.0\% , and 49.4 % 49.4\% , respectively, below both methods. ExpertLens thus identifies sufficient domain-specialized capacity to match full-model adaptation and outperforms LoRA.
blocks.zh: 专家Lens 匹配 FFT 和 优于 LORA。 6个 A显示在整个适应过程中,ExpertLens匹配或超过FFT,同时仅更新了21.7 21.7 — 47.0 % 47.0%的模型参数. 在每个培训阶段结束时,专家伦斯在数学方面分别实现了64.6%和63.8%,在医学方面分别实现了53.7%和53.6%,在遥感方面分别实现了51.9%和51.6%。 LoRA分别达到55.8%,55.8%,52.0%,52.0%,49.4%,分别低于这两种方法. 因此,ExpertLens确定了足够的域专门能力,以配合全模型的适应,并超越LORA。

blocks.en: ExpertLens accelerates adaptation. Selective adaptation also substantially reduces training time. Figure 6 B shows in-domain performance against wall-clock time. Relative to FFT, ExpertLens achieves speedups of 3.2 × 3.2\times on math, 4.0 × 4.0\times on medical, and 4.8 × 4.8\times on remote sensing, averaging 4.0 × 4.0\times over the entire training sequence. Compared with LoRA, ExpertLens trains 2.9 × 2.9\times faster and achieves higher performance across all domains. Thus, exploiting MoE modularity can yield better performance–efficiency trade-off than FFT or LoRA.
blocks.zh: 专家林斯加速适应. 选择性的适应也大大减少了培训时间。 图 6 B显示域内性能与时钟时间对战. 相较于FFFT,ExpertLens在数学上达到3.2×3.2分时速,医学上达到4.0×4.0分时速,遥感上达到4.8×4.8分时速,在整个训练序列中平均达到4.0×4.0分时速. 与LORA相比,ExpertLens的列车速度快于2.9×2.9分,在所有领域都取得了更高的性能. 因此,利用教育部模块化可以产生比FFT或LORA更好的性能效率取舍。

blocks.en: 4.2 The Importance of Expert Selection
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 挑选专家的重要性

blocks.en: We next ask whether ExpertLens gains arise from sparsity alone or from the identity of the experts being trained. In Figure 7 , we compare against two random selection baselines with the same expert budget per domain as ExpertLens . Random (full) samples from the full expert pool, while Random (disjoint) samples only experts not selected by ExpertLens . Expert subsets are resampled for each seed for both baselines. This comparison isolates the benefit of domain-relevant expert selection beyond simply updating fewer parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来要问,专家伦斯的收获是单靠麻痹还是靠培训专家的身份。 在图7中,我们比较两个随机选择基线,每个领域的专家预算与专家伦斯相同。 随机(完整的)样本来自完整的专家池,而随机(不相连的)样本则仅取自专家伦斯未选取的专家. 专家子集为两个基线的每个种子重新取样。 这种比较将域相关专家选择的好处隔离出简单的更新更少的参数.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : ExpertLens outperforms matched-budget random expert selection. ExpertLens outperforms both matched-budget random selection baselines while updating the same number of experts.
blocks.zh: 图7:专家伦斯优于预算随机选择的专家。 专家伦斯在更新相同数量的专家的同时,还超越了相应的预算随机选择基线。

blocks.en: Sparsity alone does not explain the gains. We first compare ExpertLens with Random (full) , which updates the same number of experts sampled from the full expert pool. Figure 7 shows ExpertLens consistently outperforms Random (full) , with the clearest gains on math and medical. At the end of each training stage, ExpertLens achieves 64.6 % 64.6\% versus 60.8 % 60.8\% on math, 53.7 % 53.7\% versus 52.0 % 52.0\% on medical, and 51.9 % 51.9\% versus 51.3 % 51.3\% on remote sensing. Since both methods update the same number of experts, sparsity alone cannot explain the gains; expert identity matters.
blocks.zh: 平分本身并不能解释收益。 我们首先将专家伦斯(ExpertLens)与Random(完整)进行比较,后者更新了从全部专家库中抽取的相同数量的专家. 图7显示,专家伦斯公司的业绩一直高于随机(完全)公司,在数学和医学方面收益最明显。 在每个培训阶段结束时,专家伦斯的数学成绩为64.6%、60.8%、53.7%、52.0%、51.9%和51.3%。 由于两种方法都更新了相同数量的专家,单凭麻痹无法解释所得;专家身份问题。

blocks.en: ExpertLens-selected experts are particularly effective. We next compare against Random (disjoint) , which samples the same number of experts only from those not selected by ExpertLens . Figure 7 shows that this baseline matches ExpertLens on math but falls behind on medical and remote sensing. Thus, while alternative expert subsets can suffice for some domains, ExpertLens -selected experts are more effective overall. Together with Random (full) , this shows that selective fine-tuning depends not only on sparsity, but on selecting domain-relevant experts.
blocks.zh: 专家特选专家特别有效。 我们接下来与随机(discoup)进行比较, 随机(discoup)只从专家伦斯所未选的专家中抽取同样数量的专家。 图7显示,这一基线与数学专家伦斯相对应,但在医学和遥感方面落后。 因此,虽然替代专家子集可以满足一些领域的需求,但专家伦斯----选定的专家总体上更加有效。 这与"随机"(full)一起,表明有选择性的微调不仅取决于"抽筋",而且取决于选择与域相关的专家.

blocks.en: Table 1: ExpertLens approaches privileged expert selection without using domain data for expert identification.
blocks.zh: 表1:专家伦斯在选择特权专家时不使用域数据进行专家鉴定。

blocks.en: ExpertLens approaches privileged selection. We compare ExpertLens with two count-based selectors with the same expert budget. Frequency Selection ranks experts by current-domain activation counts, while the Privileged Oracle ranks by current-domain counts minus counts from other domains. The oracle requires data from all domains, including future ones, and depends on the datasets used. Despite using no domain examples, ExpertLens achieves comparable final accuracy to both baselines (Table 1 ). Thus, ExpertLens matches count-based selection while remaining usable without target examples or future-domain knowledge.
blocks.zh: 专家伦斯接近特权选择。 我们比较了专家伦斯和两个有相同专家预算的计数选择者. 频率选择按当前域活化计数对专家进行排名,而按当前域行进的特权甲骨文按其他域倒计数. 甲骨文需要所有域的数据,包括未来域的数据,并取决于所使用的数据集. 尽管没有使用域名实例,但ExpertLens实现了与两个基准的可比较的最终准确性(表1)。 因此,ExpertLens匹配基于计数的选择,同时仍然可以使用,没有目标实例或未来域知识.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablations and Analyses
blocks.zh: 4.3 误差和分析

blocks.en: We next examine the design choices underlying ExpertLens and the robustness of selective expert adaptation. We first ablate which parameter groups are updated alongside the selected experts, then evaluate whether our conclusions depend on the ordering of the training domains.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们审查专家伦斯的设计选择和有选择的专家适应的力度。 我们首先将哪些参数组与选定的专家一起更新,然后评估我们的结论是否取决于培训领域的顺序。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Shared decoder parameters are important for effective adaptation. Progressively training the router, attention weights, and language-model head alongside the selected experts improves performance on both in-domain and out-of-domain samples, with the full ExpertLens configuration performing best across domains.
blocks.zh: 表2 共享的解码器参数对有效适应很重要。 与选定的专家一道,逐步培训路由器、注意力分量和语言模型头,提高域内和域外样本的性能,使完整的 " 专家伦斯 " 配置在各领域表现最好。

blocks.en: Shared decoder parameters are important for effective adaptation. Table 2 ablates which parameters are trained alongside ExpertLens -selected experts. In-domain performance is accuracy after training on a domain, while out-of-domain performance averages the other two. Training only selected expert MLPs yields weaker adaptation, especially on math. Adding the router improves math by 11.2 11.2 points, with QKV projections and the language-model head providing further gains across domains. These results suggest that selective adaptation benefits from updating the shared parameters that route inputs to the trained experts and shape their representations.
blocks.zh: 共享的解码器参数对于有效的适应很重要. 表2 与专家伦斯公司(专家伦斯公司)一起培训的参数减少。 域外性能在某域训练后为准确性,而域外性能平均为其他两种. 仅培训选定的专家MLPs的适应能力较弱,特别是在数学方面。 加入路由器可以使数学提高11.2 11.2分,而QKV预测和语言模型头可以提供跨域的进一步收益. 这些结果表明,更新共同的参数有助于有选择地适应,这些参数有助于向受过培训的专家提供投入,并形成他们的表述。

blocks.en: ExpertLens is robust to domain ordering. To evaluate whether our findings are sensitive to domain ordering, we repeat adaptation under three training orders in Table 3 . ExpertLens outperforms FFT in mean final accuracy under all three, by 1.7 1.7 , 2.0 2.0 , and 0.2 0.2 percentage points, respectively. It is also less sensitive to ordering, with the standard deviation across orders decreasing from 1.37 1.37 to 0.78 0.78 percentage points ( 43 % 43\% ). Although gains vary across orders, the overall benefit of selective adaptation persists across different training sequences.
blocks.zh: 专家Lens是强大的域名订购。 为了评估我们的调查结果对域令是否敏感,我们重复了表3中三个培训令下的调整。 专家林斯在所有三个下的平均最终精度都超过了FFT,分别比1.71.7,2.02.0和0.2个百分点. 订购也不太敏感,不同订单的标准偏差从1.37 1.37个百分点下降到0.78 0.78个百分点(43% 43-%)。 虽然不同订单的收益不同,但不同培训序列中选择性调整的总体惠益依然存在。

blocks.zh: 4.4 Kimi-VL实验

blocks.en: ExpertLens maintains its advantage on Kimi-VL. Table 4 reports final accuracy after the sequential adaptation sequence. ExpertLens achieves the highest mean performance at 48.0 % 48.0\% , compared with 47.4 % 47.4\% for FFT and 45.0 % 45.0\% for random selection, showing that targeted expert adaptation extends beyond Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B . blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we show that multimodal MoEs develop emergent semantic specialization across modalities, domains, and visual concepts, which can be exploited for efficient and effective adaptation. In this view, ExpertLens is a structure-aware adaptation method: instead of introducing new parameters to adapt, it leverages the model’s existing organization by identifying and updating experts already specialized for the target domain. To encourage further progress and model development, we release all data, code, and trained models.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们表明,多式联运企业在模式、领域和视觉概念方面发展出新兴的语义化专门化,可以加以利用来进行高效率和高效力的适应。 在这种观点中,ExpertLens是一种具有结构意识的适应方法:它不是引入新的参数来适应,而是通过确定和更新已经专门处理目标领域的专家来利用模型的现有组织。 为了鼓励进一步的进展和模型开发,我们公布所有数据、代码和训练有素的模型。

Sparse routing increases model capacity while improving throughput by evaluating only a small subset of the expert parameters for each token. blocks.en: We use k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) purity to quantify which factors best explain the local structure of token representations. Given the same activation vectors, we assign alternative categorical labels to each sample—e.g., semantic dataset or part of speech for text tokens, and semantic dataset, color, or spatial position for image patches—and measure how strongly nearby representations share each label. Higher kNN purity indicates that the corresponding factor better explains the local organization of the activation space.

blocks.en: Limitation: noisy classifications. We now discuss a primary limitation of ExpertLens : susceptibility to noise in token-level semantic classification. Since ExpertLens determines expert specialization from the semantic relevance of decoded vocabulary tokens, its predictions inherit errors from this token-level classification step. As shown in Table 5 , expert readouts can include ambiguous or non-semantic tokens, such as token fragments, punctuation, multilingual fragments, and control tokens. The Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B model used for classification occasionally incorrectly labels these tokens as pertaining to a specific domain. Such errors introduce noise into the inferred expert labels and represent a primary failure mode of our approach.

blocks.en: A.4.1 Routing Sharpness Analysis
blocks.zh: A.4.1 轨迹锐度分析

blocks.en: We additionally examine how routing mass is distributed among the top- K K selected experts. Figure 10 plots the mean routing weight assigned to experts at each rank, separately for image patches and text tokens across medical, math, and remote sensing domains. Across all three models, routing weights decrease smoothly with expert rank rather than collapsing onto a single expert, indicating that routing remains distributed across several selected experts. Text tokens generally exhibit sharper routing than image patches, with a larger gap between the top-ranked expert and the remaining experts. In contrast, routing profiles are broadly similar across domains within each modality, suggesting that routing sharpness is driven more strongly by modality than by domain. Overall, no model assigns more than 0.5 0.5 mean routing weight to its top-ranked expert, and even the lowest-ranked selected experts retain non-negligible routing mass, indicating that the observed expert specialization does not arise from near-deterministic routing to a single expert.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步研究了路线质量如何在KK顶级专家中分配。 图10分别列出各级别专家在医学、数学和遥感领域的图像补丁和文字符号的平均路由权重。 在所有三种模式中,路线权重随专家级别而平稳地下降,而不是倒向一名专家,这表明路线权重仍然分布在几位选定的专家中。 与图像补丁相比,文字符号一般表现出更尖锐的路由,排名最高的专家和其余的专家之间的差距较大. 相形之下,各模式内各域的路由剖面大致相近,表明路由锐度由方式驱动比由域驱动更强. 总体来说,没有任何模型为其排名最高的专家分配了超过0.5平均路由权重,即使是排名最低的被选中的专家也保留了不可忽略的路由质量,表明观察到的专家专业化并非由近乎决定性的路由给一位专家.

blocks.en: Modality preferences are robust to image scale. We test whether the modality specialization observed in § 3.1 is sensitive to image scale. blocks.en: A.4.5 Routing Stability Analysis

blocks.en: Although ExpertLens updates the router throughout continual adaptation (Table 2 ), its routing structure remains highly stable. Consecutive checkpoints preserve 92.0 − 94.0 % 92.0-94.0\% top-8 expert-set overlap, measured as the Jaccard similarity between the highest-probability experts selected for each input and layer. After completing all three training stages, the final model retains 90.1 % 90.1\% overlap with the pretrained router, with similarly high retention across Math ( 90.2 % 90.2\% ), Medical ( 90.1 % 90.1\% ), and Remote Sensing ( 89.9 % 89.9\% ) inputs. Thus, training the router enables adaptation without substantially disrupting the model’s pretrained routing structure or causing routing collapse.
blocks.zh: 虽然ExpertLens在整个持续适应过程中更新了路由器(表2),但其路由结构仍然高度稳定. 连续检查站保留92.0 - 94.0 % 92.0-94.04.0 最高8位专家的重叠,按为每一输入和每一层选定的最高概率专家之间的相近性衡量。 在完成了所有三个培训阶段之后,最终模式保留了90.1%的90.1%的路由器与经过预先培训的路由器重叠,在数学(90.2%90.2%),医学(90.1%90.1%)和遥感(89.9%89.9%)的投入中保留了同样高的比例。 因此,培训路由器可以进行改造,而不会严重地破坏该模型事先经过训练的路由结构或造成路由倒塌。

blocks.en: A.5.1 Training Details
blocks.zh: A.5.1 培训细节

blocks.en: Training Data and Rewards. We train on 4,000 4{,}000 examples per domain, sampled from the corresponding training splits. For math, all samples are from Mmk12 ( Meng et al., 2025 ) . For medical, we use all 1,793 1{,}793 samples from VqaRad ( Lau et al., 2018 ) and 2,207 2{,}207 examples from PathVqa ( He et al., 2020 ) . For remote sensing, we sample 2,000 2{,}000 examples each from RsVqaLr ( Lobry et al., 2020 ) and RsVqaHr ( Lobry et al., 2020 ) . We adopt the system prompt and reward functions from VERO ( Sarch et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 培训数据和奖励。 我们每个域训练4000 4{,}000个例子,从相应的训练分出样本。 就数学而言,所有样本都来自Mmk12(Meng等人,2025年)。 在医疗方面,我们使用来自VqaRad的1,793个样本(Lau等人,2018年)和来自PathVqa的2,207 2{,}207个实例(He等人,2020年)。 就遥感而言,我们从RsVqaLr(Lobry等,2020年)和RsVqaHr(Lobry等,2020年)各抽样2,000个实例。 我们采用由VERO(Sarch等人,2026年)提供及时和奖励的系统。

blocks.en: Implementation. We use Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B as our base multimodal MoE and GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) as our post-training algorithm. All experiments are conducted on 4 4 H200 GPUs for 200 200 steps per domain, with a batch size of 32 32 , group size of 5 5 , and learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} . We use verl ( Sheng et al., 2025 ) for training. Additional hyperparameters are provided in Table 7 . We show results for three seeds, with shaded regions indicating 95 % 95\% confidence intervals.

preprocessing, decoding parameters, and evaluation seeds for all methods.
